findings: Viewed60 additional images, cumulative90/175 main corpus assets. Groups include background/alpha variants, chromaticity/physical-axis examples, palette/histogram/significant-bit variants, text/EXIF, filters0..4, gray/color gamma ramps.
Physical-axis examples visible as narrow or stretched color patterns; this preview alone does not establish own physical-pixel geometry comparison policy.
Filter images visibly show labels0..4; metadata/text variants sometimes contain differing visible patches, so filenames alone must not be treated as equivalent-image oracle.
Gamma ramp previews show graded labeled bands; native rendered appearance is not a linear color measurement or16-bit precision proof.
No new heavy task started during shared resource window; earlier161 own decode and15 exact pair tests remain separate numeric evidence.
